long_biography.plain_text:
LaVan built his first business around supplying alternative fill to county landfills, an early application of soil recycling in New Jersey. The work expanded nationally as contaminated and underused industrial sites needed cost-effective material management. He later served as a founding executive of two publicly traded start-ups, combining operating growth with capital-market experience.

In 2007, LaVan became a partner at Impact Environmental. He helped broaden the firm beyond consulting and soil brokerage into remediation, waste management, recycled materials, construction preparation and brownfield redevelopment. As principal, he remains associated with the operating platform that turns environmental cleanup and material reuse into development-ready land.
